title: Evaluating Token Probabilities as Confidence Estimators in Human Behavior Simulations: A Case Study in Luxembourgish Next Like Prediction
title_zh: 在人类行为模拟中将词元概率作为置信度估计器的评估：卢森堡语下一条点赞预测的案例研究

paragraphs.en: 研究检验开放权重LLM词元概率作为置信度估计器，发现监督微调可显著提升下一条点赞预测的准确率与校准。 As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior, their operational validity is typically assessed through accuracy alone, implicitly treating human behavior as deterministic. We argue that on noisy digital trace data, a model's performance depends not only on predicting the correct outcome but on its calibration. We present a case study testing whether the token probabilities of open-weight LLMs can serve as confidence estimates in a Next Like Prediction task: predicting how a user of the Luxembourgish news platform RTL.lu rates a comment, conditioned on their prior interactions. Evaluating Ministral 3 (3B, 8B), we find that, with in-context learning only, the tested models are overconfident and are outperformed on accuracy and calibration by a simple statistical baseline. Accuracy and calibration do not move together: scaling from 3B to 8B improves accuracy while degrading calibration, and longer behavioral histories raise accuracy while confidence declines. Task-specific supervised fine-tuning acts as an effective calibration intervention, reducing Expected Calibration Error from 0.2 to 0.006 while improving accuracy from 0.536 to 0.758. We conclude that confidence estimation should be evaluated alongside accuracy to improve validity when using LLM-based agents.
paragraphs.zh: 研究检验开放权重LLM词元概率作为置信度估计器，发现监督微调可显著提升下一条点赞预测的准确率与校准。随着大语言模型（LLM）被越来越多地用于模拟人类行为，其操作有效性通常仅通过准确率来评估，这隐含地将人类行为视为确定性的。 我们认为，在有噪声的数字痕迹数据上，模型的性能不仅取决于预测出正确结果，还取决于其校准程度。 我们呈现了一个案例研究，检验开放权重LLM的词元概率能否在下一条点赞预测任务中作为置信度估计：即基于用户先前的交互，预测卢森堡新闻平台RTL.lu的用户会如何评价一条评论。 通过对Ministral 3（3B、8B）的评估，我们发现，仅使用上下文学习时，被测试的模型过度自信，在准确率和校准上均不如一个简单的统计基线。 准确率与校准并不同步变化：从3B扩展到8B提升了准确率却降低了校准，而更长的行为历史提高了准确率但置信度却下降。 针对任务的监督微调是一种有效的校准干预手段，将期望校准误差从0.2降至0.006，同时将准确率从0.536提升至0.758。 我们得出结论，在使用基于LLM的智能体时，应将置信度估计与准确率一同评估，以提升有效性。
